About the position

Are you ambitious, commercially minded, and eager to take the next step in your career within the intersection of strategy, branding, sales and marketing?

As a Consultant/Senior Consultant in Sunrise’s Insights & Strategy team, you’ll work with ambitious Danish and international companies to turn customer, market, and business insights into strategic direction and creative solutions with commercial impact.

Your main objective will be to create strong market positions for our clients and accelerate their business growth by helping them navigate transitions across three critical domains: Brand Transition, Marketing Transition, and Sales Transition. Especially within complex business-to-business (B2B) environments. This requires a combination of thorough analysis, insight-driven strategy, commercial thinking, and an understanding of how strategy translates into creative execution or actionable initiatives.

You will take an active role throughout our projects – from research and analysis to developing strategic recommendations, preparing and participating in client workshops, and translating strategy into clear briefs and direction for our creative and activation specialists.

We are looking for someone with 2-4 years of relevant experience from a consultancy, agency, or an in-house strategy, marketing, insights, or commercial function. You know how to structure a problem, work independently with analysis and strategic deliverables, and communicate your thinking clearly – while still being eager to learn from experienced colleagues and take on increasing responsibility.

Depending on your experience, you’ll either own key parts of our projects or take the lead on workstreams and day-to-day client contact.

At Sunrise, you will be part of a social, ambitious, and informal organization where you’ll work closely with consultants, specialists, project managers, and partners – with direct client exposure and responsibility from day one.

Your tasks will include

• Conducting and driving desk research, market analysis, competitor analysis, and qualitative and quantitative insights gathering

• Turning complex data, research, and customer insights into clear conclusions and strategic recommendations

• Challenging our clients’ business issues and identifying untapped potential across their commercial activities

• Developing strategies within areas such as positioning, commercial, branding, customer insights, communication, and marketing

• Contributing to and independently owning parts of client projects and strategic deliverables, and driving client engagements and workstreams independently (or with the ambition to gradually take on this responsibility)

• Preparing, facilitating and presenting at client meetings and workshops

• Translating strategic recommendations into clear input and briefs for our creative teams and Activation specialists across areas such as content, SoMe, Web, CRM, and campaigns

• Developing compelling presentations in Keynote/PowerPoint for existing and potential clients

• Contributing to and co-owning new business development through research, identification of opportunities, development of proposals, and pitches

• Planning and managing research projects with external partners (qual/quant)

Your profile

• You have 2-4 years of relevant professional experience from a consultancy, agency, or an in-house strategy, marketing, insights, branding, or commercial function

• You hold a relevant master’s degree within business administration, marketing, management, communication, or a related field

• You have a strong interest in marketing, branding, commercial strategy, customer insights, and communication

• You are analytically strong and comfortable working with both qualitative and quantitative insights – but equally importantly

• You have solid business acumen and are curious about how companies, customers, markets, and brands work – B2B experience is a benefit but not a requirement

• You are a structured problem solver who can take ownership of your own workstreams and deliverables

• You are a strategic thinker with a creative flair and enjoy moving from analysis to ideas and solutions

• You are a strong team player who enjoys collaborating across different disciplines and personalities

• You are eager to take responsibility, learn quickly, and continuously develop your consulting toolbox

• You are fluent in Danish and highly proficient in English

• It is a plus if you have experience in facilitating workshops and presenting to senior stakeholders

• It is a plus if you are interested in and have strong skillset within various AI tools and want to take a leading role in challenging existing processes from this point of view

We offer

• A steep learning curve with increasing responsibility and client exposure

• A clear path towards senior roles, and real influence on how we develop our methods and offering

• The opportunity to work with leading Danish and international companies across industries

• Personal and professional development with close sparring from experienced consultants and partners

• Exposure to projects spanning insights, commercial strategy, positioning, branding, communication, and marketing

• The opportunity to follow projects all the way from analysis and strategy to creative development and activation or actionable business initiatives

• An ambitious and personalized development path with long-term career opportunities at Sunrise

• A social, informal, and ambitious work environment in Copenhagen

About Sunrise TcTa

Sunrise TcTa isn’t a large conglomerate with standardised processes. We’re a privately owned commercial transition agency based in Copenhagen – independent and built to develop tailor-made strategic and creative solutions across industries, mostly B2B and often with an international footprint.

We’re a team of 30+ advisors, strategists, creatives, project managers, and specialists working closely together to help companies navigate change and unlock commercial growth – all while having a lot of fun along the way. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves: expect an open culture where every voice is heard, music in the office, plenty of laughter, and a calendar with social events and celebrations.

We combine customer and market insights, strategy, creativity, and activation – allowing us to move from identifying the commercial challenge to developing the strategic direction and bringing it to life.

Our ambition level is high, our pace is fast, and our structure is deliberately informal. You’ll work closely with experienced colleagues and partners, get responsibility early, and have the opportunity to make a visible impact on both our clients’ businesses and Sunrise itself.

Transitions are never easy.

But they’re often necessary.

Join us in working with the commercial ones.

Sunrise TcTa – Brand, Marketing & Commercial Strategy.

How to apply

Submit the form below. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible. We look forward to receiving your CV and motivational letter.

**Are you ready to turn strategy into action and create visible impact at the heart of a dynamic production site?

**At Kruså Dairy, we are looking for a commercially minded and highly structured Business Development Manager who can connect strategy, people and execution. Working closely with the Site Director and the site leadership team, you will help shape the direction of the dairy and ensure that the right priorities and projects move forward.

If you enjoy the analytical and strategic side of consulting but want to get closer to implementation and see the results of your work, this could be the right next step for you.

**How You Will Make An Impact

**As Business Development Manager, you will act as a trusted sparring partner and right hand to the Site Director. You will consolidate input from across the site, translate strategic ambitions into a clear business plan and create alignment on the initiatives that will deliver the greatest value. The environment is fast-moving, and priorities can change quickly, so your ability to bring structure, remain agile and keep stakeholders connected will be key.

Your main responsibilities will be to

• Drive the strategic business planning process by gathering input across the site, challenging assumptions and translating priorities into a coherent short- and long-term plan for our product growth and innovation ambitions

• Turn strategy into execution by identifying, structuring and driving larger cross-functional projects that improve site performance and support Kruså Dairy’s ambitions. Drive our sustainability agenda to reduce our CO2 footprint with innovation projects at our waste water plant or reducing energy consumptions of our production facility

• Build strong investment cases by aligning CAPEX, savings and improvement opportunities with the site leadership team, Finance and the central CAPEX stakeholders in Viby

• Support fact-based decision-making through clear analyses, business cases, presentations, performance insights and decision material for the Site Director and leadership team

• Create alignment and momentum by connecting stakeholders, communicating strategic priorities and following up on actions, milestones and value delivery across the project portfolio

The role is based at Kruså Dairy, where you will work closely with the Site Director, the site leadership team and key stakeholders across Arla, including Finance and CAPEX colleagues in Viby. While the role offers a high degree of independence, your success will depend on your ability to involve others, listen to different perspectives and create shared ownership of the site’s agenda. There is flexibility to balance time on site and working from home in line with business and team needs.

**What Will Make You Successful

**We are looking for a person who brings a strategic and analytical mindset and enjoys turning complex information into clear priorities and practical actions. You are structured, curious and proactive, and you feel comfortable taking ownership while also involving others and valuing their perspectives. With a flexible and constructive approach, you navigate changing priorities and build trusting relationships through sound judgement, openness and clear communication. Besides this, we imagine that you bring

• A relevant master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Strategy, Economics, Engineering or a related field

• Experience from management consulting, business development, finance or strategy, combined with a motivation to turn problem-solving into hands-on implementation

• A solid understanding of how to identify and create value in a production environment

• Experience from manufacturing, operations, Lean or Six Sigma is an advantage, but not a requirement

• Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

**What do we offer?

**As our new Business Development Manager, you will work close to the strategic core of Kruså Dairy and influence decisions with tangible impact. The role offers broad exposure across strategy, operations, finance and continuous improvement, along with the autonomy to shape your agenda and support from the site leadership team and wider Arla network.

**Would you like to join us?

**If you want to combine strategy with implementation and help shape the future of Kruså Dairy, we would love to hear from you.

Please apply as soon as possible, as we will review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. The recruitment will close once the right candidate has been found. For questions, please contact Site Director, Nicoline Akkerman at +45 91315826.

**Shape the Future of Dairy

**Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

**Your impact begins here

**As Senior Portfolio Manager, you will help ADI make clearer, faster decisions about where its effort goes. You will partner with ADI areas to manage their activity portfolios, turn portfolio data into insight decision makers can act on, and strengthen the concepts and tools behind governance and annual planning. Your work brings transparency to trade-offs across Research & Development, so the right activities move forward with momentum, and resources go where they create the most value.

**What You’ll Bring

**You know how to turn complex portfolio data into clear recommendations, and how to bring people with you when you have no formal authority. You will also bring:

• A master’s degree in business administration, economics, finance, engineering, life sciences or another relevant field.

• 5–8 years of relevant experience in portfolio management, business planning, consulting, project management, change management or a related discipline.

• Experience creating and quality-assuring portfolio, product or financial data, analyses, reporting and decision materials for senior stakeholders.

• A proven ability to solve problems, plan and execute workstreams, manage improvement initiatives and coach stakeholders in a complex matrix organisation.

• A solid understanding of business processes, governance and annual planning cycles.

• Strong analytical, facilitation and communication skills, with sound judgement and the ability to navigate ambiguity and competing priorities.

• Fluent English.

Desirable, but not essential: Pharmaceutical or healthcare industry experience; experience with portfolio or work-management tools; experience using automation or AI-enabled tools to improve workflows; certifications in Lean Six Sigma, agile project management, change management or product management.

**What You’ll Do

**You will make portfolio management and governance work in practice – simple to use, grounded in data and focused on value.

• Partner with selected ADI areas to manage their activity portfolios, ensuring alignment with business strategy, value-based decisions and effective tracking of performance and outcomes.

• Turn portfolio data into actionable insights, dashboards and presentations, and represent Portfolio Management & Governance in selected ADI and R&D governance forums.

• Own and evolve selected concepts, artefacts and tools, such as the activity-based cost model, value framework, Product Team Playbook and the portfolio management and OKR environment in Azure DevOps, so they stay current and easy to use.

• Lead improvement projects end to end to update, replace or automate portfolio concepts, tools and processes, testing and scaling AI-enabled tools where they improve data quality, efficiency or user experience.

• Drive adoption of new ways of working, with a focus on the annual planning cycle, by coaching stakeholders across the matrix and building alignment without formal authority.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Portfolio Management & Governance team within ADI, part of R&D, and report to the Head of Portfolio Management & Governance. In R&D, colleagues explore scientific ideas and advance them towards clinical testing, bringing together curiosity, data, technology, collaboration and operational excellence.

Your closest partners will be leadership and executing teams in your assigned ADI areas, together with your Portfolio Management & Governance colleagues. You will also work with ADI Finance and support functions such as Product Management Excellence and Tech Delivery Excellence, R&D line-of-business stakeholders who sponsor, enable or adopt ADI projects and products, and the governance bodies that set priorities. Externally, you will work with consultants and partners supporting portfolio concepts, tools and improvement initiatives.

With a global scope, you will bring these perspectives together, create clarity on trade-offs and help decisions move forward at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to work with a high degree of autonomy, making independent recommendations, leading projects from scope to benefit realisation and guiding colleagues as a subject-matter expert. Your voice will shape how portfolio decisions are prepared and made across ADI.

You will build new skills through hands-on work with data, automation and AI-enabled tools, as Novo upskills its workforce to advance AI as a driver of innovation. You will also contribute to team priorities and knowledge sharing in a team that values respect, honest feedback and continuous improvement.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary for employees based in Denmark ranges from 742,600 to 1,091,600 DKK. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring clarity and momentum to portfolio decisions across R&D, apply by 23 October 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We are an equal opportunities employer and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants.

Are you keen to support an organization that's on an exciting data journey? Then come join TDC Brands.

As the Data Governance Specialist, you will be a member of the Data Office, responsible for supporting and developing data governance initiatives across the organization. In this role you will work flexibly between the Data Office and embedded in business units to make data roles work day-to-day: enabling data consumers, assisting Data Domain Owners and Data Stewards.

You will have an important role in supporting data governance by working collaboratively with the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Enable Data Consumers:

• Support adoption of the strategic data platform and the Enterprise Business Glossary (EBG) among data consumers in your business domain, including AI and agentic consumers.

• Help consumers find, understand, and trust governed data so it actually gets used for business insights and automation.

Assist Data Domain Owners:

• Support your Data Domain Owner(s) in maturing the data domain map and semantic models.

• Align with Tech, DPO and Legal as needed when data domain priorities, critical data elements, or AI classifications are being set.

• Flag gaps early — missing owners, unclear sources, unresolved dependencies — so each wave starts on solid ground.

Assist Data Stewards:

• Provide on-demand support to Data Stewards as they assess and authorize changes and stay accountable for data quality at source.

Stakeholder Engagement and Communication:

• Act as the day-to-day point of contact for Data Domain Owners, Data Stewards, Glossary Term Owners and data consumers.

• Escalate issues that need central Data Office, Tech, DPO or Legal involvement.

Bonus

Experience with telecoms, familiarity with data cataloging tools, or an interest in how governed data enables AI and agentic use cases.

Qualifications

As a Data Governance Specialist, we expect you to have sufficient years' experience in data management and data governance. You most likely come from an industry that prioritizes critical and valuable data assets and applies 'just enough' data governance.

Key expectations of the role are having great communication skills, comfort in operating pragmatically ahead of a fully defined policy landscape, and an ability to interact with people across the organization to produce tangible benefits to our data and AI initiatives.

Application: It is not necessary to attach a cover letter, but please include a brief introduction in your CV about why you are applying for this position. To ensure a fair and inclusive recruitment process, we kindly ask you to refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

Application date: 30-11-2026

Contact person: Paul Makkar Email: pmak@nuuday.nuuway.dk

Work location: Teglholmsgade 1, Copenhagen

We’re looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager, to serve our customers on the Danish market and ensure a strong long term relationship. You will handle customer cycles from onboarding to renewal, and be able to have a clear impact on how we serve our customers now and going forward.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**You will join our current team of three in Customer Success, along with our Danish-focused sales team, to work on serving our Danish-speaking customers. As an early member of the team, you will be able to have an instant impact on the customer experience.

This is a full-cycle CSM position, which means you will handle everything from onboarding to renewal. This means we’re looking for someone who is passionate about strong customer relations, but ideally also with a knack for teaching. When it comes to contracts and numbers, you’ll be working closely with our account executives to ensure we find the best fit for our customers.

As the team is young, we hope that you will also want to be a part of shaping the processes and future of CS at Pandektes.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Onboarding customers - Teach lawyers and legal professionals how AI can superpower their legal research

• Drive adoption - Collaborate with management/executives to ensure adoption and success

• Build community - Find superusers and empower them to do even more with Pandektes

• Foster growth - Identify expansion opportunities and work with the rest of our team to expand our presence at existing customers

**What You’ll Bring

**

• Fluency in Danish and English

• Entrepreneurial mindset, motivated by creating good relationships, top-notch customer experience and driving growth as part of our commercial team

• Excellent communication skills and strong ability to build trust – we value long-term customer relationships

• Eagerness to learn and openness to feedback; you value insights from others and use them to grow

• Proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

• Strong interest in technology and enthusiasm for AI (basic knowledge of AI and LLMs is a plus)

• Willingness to develop deep knowledge of how lawyers work and conduct legal research (a legal background is an advantage but not required)

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value ownership – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in Copenhagen, Hamburg, London and Zurich. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**What we offer

**

• Competitive compensation + commission based pay

• An attractive warrant program

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

• Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses

• Paid parental leave

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

_In Talent Strategy, support the VP Talent on the executive talent agenda; coordinate the annual executive talent wheel with strong preparation and sharp insights, contribute to the Talent COE milestones and KPIs tracking, and support strategic projects for the Executive Leadership Team and the Board through critical moments of transformation.

In Talent Attraction, be the subject matter expert and own the enterprise hiring and assessment standards, processes and tools, enabling global high-quality hiring.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Partner with the VP Talent to enable the executive talent agenda, supporting the Executive Leadership Team and the Board through critical moments of transformation

• Support the executive talent agenda: coordinate the annual talent wheel and associated processes, ensuring relevance, strong preparation and sharp insights

• Support the VP Talent in prioritizing initiatives and tracking milestones and KPIs of the COE

• Motivation to expand business strategy impact through subject matter ownership in Talent Attraction and Assessment

• Experience co-creating effective standards and governance that meet market needs and drive adoption across the matrix organization

• Strong project leadership on multi-year transformation roadmaps

• Data-literate and AI savvy, using hiring KPIs to drive decisions and creating outstanding executive-ready materials

• A hands-on approach and willingness to take on and deliver multiple tasks independently

**What You Will Deliver

**

• An executive talent cycle that is well prepared, insight-led and supported to run on time

Icing on the cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

At Pandora, we believe that creating an inclusive and diverse workplace and reflecting societal diversity in our customer engagement is essential to delivering on our company purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We dedicate ourselves to fostering, cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and diversity where everyone feels respected and valued.

NDURE is building the world's first continuous lactate tracker, think CGM, but for lactate. The device streams physiological data continuously, for days at a time, and we're building the software layer that turns that raw signal into something athletes and coaches can actually use, from elite performance to everyday training. This is unsolved territory: nobody has made continuous lactate data useful in real time before, and we're the ones building it first.

_We only accept applicants that are EU citizens already living in Denmark or willing to relocate to Denmark. If this does not apply to you, please do not apply. We are unable to assist with visas.

_**Key Outcomes

**

• Design the core architecture of the application, data, backend, and infrastructure, from scratch.

• Build the app on top of it: real time lactate display, readable mid session.

• Build the codebase and systems in a way that a growing software team can build on, not just you.

• Work with our CTO and sensor team. Understand what the hardware actually produces, and build for its imperfections.

**Core Requirements

**

• A few years of experience designing system architecture, you've made the calls on how data, backend, and infrastructure fit together from early on.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure and data pipelines, ideally including time series, IoT, or continuous sensor data.

• Comfortable with mobile or cross platform development and BLE data handling specifically.

• You take initiative and solve problems without waiting to be told exactly what to do.

• Eligible to work in Denmark, on site at our office in Kongens Lyngby, Copenhagen, available to start as soon as possible.

**Ideal Background

**

• Experience with wearables, or other data-sensitive consumer products, where privacy and data handling weren't an afterthought.

• Genuine interest in sport, physiology, or performance data.

**You'll Thrive Here If

**

• You care about performance and want to build for people chasing it, from Olympic hopefuls to weekend athletes.

• You've felt what a bad app does to good data, and you don't want to be the one who ships that.

• You like to take ownership of your work and want to move fast.

• You like working with an ambitious team.

**What We Offer

**

• Full time, paid position with equity warrants.

• Real architectural ownership: what you design now is what NDURE runs on for years.

• Direct access to the founding team and the decisions shaping the company.

• First engineer on the software team, which will grow fast around what you build.

• Starting date: As soon as possible.

If this sounds like the problem you want to spend the next few years solving, join us.

NDURE, The Future of Performance.

Job Description:

Are you a skilled and detail-oriented tester with a passion for delivering high-quality digital solutions?

At Satair, we are looking for a Backend API Automation Tester who will ensure our e-commerce platform and underlying services meet the highest standards of functionality, performance, and reliability. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on building robust automation frameworks and ensuring that the "engine" of our digital ecosystem is flawless.

The position will be located in Copenhagen, Denmark.

What The Job Is...

You'll play a crucial role in shaping the quality of our platform by leveraging your expertise in backend automation, security validation, and defect analysis. You will work closely with developers, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure our backend services are scalable and resilient, contributing directly to our mission of delivering seamless customer experience.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks specifically for backend services and APIs.

• API Automation: Create and execute sophisticated API tests using Playwright .Security & Auth: Automate complex authentication flows, including OAuth, JWT, and API keys, to ensure secure service-to-service communication.

• Validation: Validate RESTful (and SOAP) APIs for functionality, performance, and schema integrity (JSON/XML).

• CI/CD Integration: Implement and manage automated test suites within CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to enable continuous quality.

• Defect Management: Analyze test results, identify root causes of defects, and collaborate with developers to ensure timely resolutions.

• Strategy & Documentation: Develop comprehensive test cases, test plans, and data strategies for backend systems, ensuring high test coverage and clear API documentation.

• Full Lifecycle Testing: Conduct regression, smoke and integration testing to support frequent production releases.

How You Will Contribute To The Team

• Technical Expertise: 5-7 years of experience in backend/API testing with deep hands-on experience in Playwright.

• Scripting Skills: Proficiency in automation scripting using JavaScript or TypeScript.

• Protocol Mastery: Solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, headers, status codes and version control (Git).

• Agile Knowledge: Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies, Jira and modern test management tools like XRAY, HP ALM, Practi Test.

• Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to identifying bottlenecks and optimizing automation frameworks for speed and reliability.

• Stakeholder Acumen: Strong communication skills to bridge the gap between technical backend requirements and business needs.

• Collaboration: Ability to work within diverse teams and foster a positive, solutions-oriented environment.

Nice to Have

• Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or K6.

• ISTQB Foundation Certification.

• Experience with E-commerce platform architectures.

What does your next challenge look like?

At Satair, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow.

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

About SATAIR

Satair offers first class material management solutions in the aftermarket business of the aviation industry.

We are working to be the most customer-centric organization in providing commercial aviation spares parts to make the world continue flying.

We are constantly taking customer experience to new levels by improving how we fulfill and deliver customers’ orders quickly and accurately, anywhere in the world.

To meet this goal, Satair is continually striving to innovate and provide best-in-class service levels by pioneering new products and services in a fast growing business environment.

With our global functional organization spanning across 11 different sites and locations worldwide with more than 1.800 people and a turnover of $3.0 billion, you will be part of a truly global family.

Our customers have the ultimate goal to operate their fleet and our Airbus aircraft safely, efficiently in a cost-time-quality effective manner and of course with the expected comfort level for their customers. We at Satair do everything to support our customers in this.

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

Optimize the distribution network

Turn photonic quantum processors into real-world value

You will act as the bridge between our theory, experimental, and business teams and our end users. You will take an end user's problem, work out how our hardware can address it, and turn it into a concrete plan that you help execute together with the teams.

This is a technical role with a clear focus on applications. You have the theoretical depth to develop applications yourself, with an eye for the quantum algorithms behind them, the experimental insight to discuss feasibility with our experimentalists, and the overview to translate between what end users need and what our hardware can do. You are expected to take initiative and move from a loosely defined question to a workable solution.

Responsibilities of the role

• 
Identify and develop use cases and quantum algorithms for our demonstrator, from initial end-user needs to proof of concept

• 
Translate end-user problems into well-defined computational tasks, and assess where our hardware can offer value

• 
Discuss feasibility with our experimental team, and feedback which hardware capabilities matter most for applications

• 
Run and guide simulations of algorithms and use cases to benchmark performance and compare against classical approaches

• 
Join end-user meetings initiated by the business team as the technical bridge, and turn results into clear recommendations

• 
Work with the business team on proposals, demonstrations, partnerships, and funding applications

• 
Represent Sparrow Quantum at conferences, workshops, and end-user meetings

In brief, we offer a unique opportunity for a talented Quantum Applications Scientist to collaborate with world-leading professionals in the field. Your work will shape how end users apply our quantum hardware and help steer our technology towards the problems that matter most.

Required qualifications

• 
PhD in quantum physics or a closely related field, with a strong theoretical foundation, ideally with postdoctoral or industry experience

• 
Good understanding of quantum computing use cases and where they may offer an advantage, e.g. in optimization, machine learning or simulation, with an interest in the underlying algorithms

• 
Worked alongside experimentalists, giving you a solid sense of what is experimentally feasible

• 
Solid programming skills, e.g. in Python, for simulating and benchmarking algorithms

• 
Proven ability to communicate complex technical ideas to non-specialists, including end users and business stakeholders

Nice-to-have qualifications

• 
Experience with quantum photonics, quantum optics or photonic quantum computing

• 
Experience working with industry partners, customers or end users on applied projects

• 
Experience leading projects or supervising junior researchers

• 
Experience with collaborative R&D projects or funding applications

• 
Knowledge of boson sampling, measurement-based or fusion-based quantum computing

• 
A track record of publications in quantum technologies

Additionally, we expect that you thrive in a collaborative work environment and are inspired by the chance to contribute to groundbreaking advancements in quantum computing.

Desired abilities & competencies

• 
Overview: you keep the big picture in view and connect technical detail to what matters for the end user and for Sparrow Quantum.

• 
Translator: you are equally comfortable discussing algorithms with theorists, feasibility with experimentalists and value with end users.

• 
Proactive and solution-oriented: you spot opportunities, take the first step, and come back with options rather than obstacles.

• 
Constructive challenger: you are confident challenging assumptions, just as open to having your own challenged, and look for solutions that work both for the end user and for our hardware.

What we offer

Passionate international team and high individual impact: Join a high-performance team of dynamic and highly motivated international professionals working towards photonic quantum computing. Your innovative ideas, unique perspectives, and unwavering drive to succeed are essential to the team and will have a direct impact on the future of our organization.

Cutting-edge projects and world-renowned collaborators: Collaborate with world-renowned companies and researchers, working on cutting-edge projects that will shape the future of quantum technology. Our commitment to your growth and development is reflected in our supportive culture, which includes group-based knowledge transfer, skill development, and opportunities for training and mentorship.

• 
Attractive compensation and career advancement opportunities: Receive a salary that is competitive and commensurate with your qualifications, with ample opportunities to advance your career and achieve your professional goals.

About the Role:

QuNorth is looking for a Quantum Error Correction (QEC) Lead to help develop and lead our collaborative Quantum Error Correction program, in addition to participating in other aspects of operationalizing Magne, QuNorth’s Neutral Atom quantum computer, in a fast-paced but stable startup environment.

QuNorth is a new Nordic Hub for quantum exploration, providing the region’s enterprises, researchers, and startups with the capability to test, learn, and build on Magne, a world-leading Level 2 quantum computer. With strong backing from EIFO and the Novo Nordisk Foundation, QuNorth will operate Magne as a shared platform for Nordic industries, research organisations, and start-ups. Our aim is to provide the access, tools, expertise, and support needed to explore new quantum applications across all relevant areas, including, but not limited to, life sciences, innovative materials, biochemistry, and AI.

Magne’s physical layer, developed by Atom Computing, includes 1200+ Ytterbium-171 atoms, serving as physical qubits with all-to-all connectivity. It can be operated seamlessly in logical mode enabled by Microsoft, providing tens of logical qubits depending on QEC code. Magne can also be operated in physical mode with mid-circuit measurement and feedforward, which in conjunction with its all-to-all connectivity at scale turns Magne into an excellent platform for exploration of novel QEC techniques, unconstrained by “chip topology”. We envision QEC projects and broader QEC-related partnerships to be a strong component of QuNorth’s portfolio. Working directly with the CTO, and interfacing with the CPO team and QuNorth’s users and partners, the QEC Lead will help shape this key component of the QuNorth portfolio. This role will, at least initially, be mostly a technical leadership role, rather than a managerial position.

We are a small and committed team working to build QuNorth from the ground up as a reliable and transparent organization that contributes to the long-term strength of the Nordic quantum computing ecosystem.

The successful candidate will eagerly engage in many of the following directions:

• Lead QuNorth’s technical work on quantum error correction, including strategy, architecture assessment, simulation, benchmarking, resource estimation, and roadmap development.

• Evaluate and compare QEC codes, decoding approaches, logical gate schemes, error models, and fault-tolerant architectures.

• Work with hardware, software, and theory collaborators to connect QEC requirements and assumptions to realistic device constraints.

• Help identify which QEC approaches are most relevant to QuNorth’s mission and which are not.

• Participate in broader company-building work, including technical due diligence, collaborator or partner discussions, product strategy, documentation, and operational tasks.

• Use AI tools effectively and responsibly to accelerate research, coding, literature review, writing, planning, analysis, operations, and internal workflows.

• Help establish a high standard for scientific rigor, clear communication, and effective execution within the company.
